description: This file defines the Doctrine ORM entity class 'BuzzLink' for representing links associated with 'BuzzPost' within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It encapsulates properties such as id, post, link, and original link, along with their getters and setters, and maps to the 'ohrm_buzz_link' database table.

classes.name: BuzzLink
classes.description: ORM entity class for managing link data related to BuzzPost entries, including link URL and original link.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Primary key identifier for the link record.

properties.name: post
properties.description: Reference to the associated BuzzPost entity.

properties.name: originalLink
properties.description: Original URL of the link, stored optionally.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the BuzzLink.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the BuzzLink.

methods.name: setPost
methods.description: Associates a BuzzPost entity with this link.
